notes.title: Update: Major Fixes & Improvements
notes.content: [p]Major Fixes [/p][list][*][p]Checkpoints now correctly save progress after completing a quest.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera effect was missing when using items or encountering jump scares.,[/p][/*][*][p]Route markers no longer disappear after saving and reloading the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]Anomalies no longer instantly kill the player: they now deal only mental damage as intended. Damage balance has been adjusted for correct behavior.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a jumpscare inside the car could appear multiple times in a row.,[/p][/*][/list][p]Interface & Controls [/p][list][*][p]Added colors to tutorial key prompts for better readability.,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tutorial text descriptions.,[/p][/*][*][p]Manual gear shifting with Shift and Control has been removed.,[/p][/*][*][p]In fullscreen mode, the mouse is now correctly locked to the screen and no longer “jumps” between monitors.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkeys to the car interface.,[/p][/*][/list][p] Menu & Settings [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with the menu slider.[/p][/*][/list]
